## Summary

Implemented F005 of plan 2026-05-24-004 — cross-channel snapshot fixtures, authoring guide, and CHANGELOG entry. Added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_event_messaging_snapshots_f005.py` (19 tests, parametrized over all 16 LIVE / DASHBOARD_ACTION inbox-event kinds) plus 16 pinned JSON snapshots under `tests/fixtures/event_messaging_snapshots/` — each LIVE kind pins all 4 channels (Discord embed, terminal payload, INBOX rendered block, dashboard sidecar dict) and each DASHBOARD_ACTION kind pins the 2 it renders to. Cross-channel parity for the six highest-value kinds (gate_hit, breaker_tripped, both volley_terminal variants, no_progress_classification, verdict_mismatch) is enforced by a dedicated totality test; a separate sanitization test walks every fixture string against `SECRET_REGEXES` to satisfy acceptance #4. Wrote `docs/event-messaging-authoring-guide.md` covering disposition selection, copy-map vocabulary references, honest-commands rule, command-validation harness, snapshot regeneration via `DONTPANIC_SNAPSHOT_UPDATE=1`, and per-sink notes. Added a CHANGELOG entry naming all four product-facing format changes. Regression sw
